Kazakh

[edit]
Alternative scripts
Arabic ميلليون
Cyrillic миллион
Latin million
Kazakh cardinal numbers
 <  105 106 107  > 
    Cardinal : миллион (million)
    Ordinal : миллионыншы (millionynşy)

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian миллио́н (millión), from French million, from Italian milione.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [mʲɪlʲɪˈon]

Numeral

[edit]

миллион • (million)

  1. million

Russian

[edit]
Russian numbers (edit)
[a], [b] ←  1,000  ←  100,000 1,000,000 (106) 1,000,000,000 (109)  → [a], [b] 1012  →

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • милліо́нъ (millión) — pre-1918 spelling
  • мильо́н (milʹón), мильён (milʹjón) — low colloquial

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French million, from Italian milione, from Latin mīlle.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [mʲɪlʲ(ː)ɪˈon]
  • Audio; [mʲɪlʲːɪˈon]:(file)
  • IPA(key): [mʲɪˈlʲjɵn] (phonetic respelling: милльён) (colloquial, acceptable)

Numeral

[edit]

миллио́н • (millión) m [with genitive plural noun ‘items, etc.’]

  1. million (1,000,000)
    Synonyms: (colloquial) лимо́н (limón), (slang) лям (ljam)

Usage notes

[edit]
  • миллион (million) in all cases governs the genitive plural of the noun.

Descendants

[edit]

Descendants probably from Russian, but possibly from other European languages.

  • → Chechen: миллион (million)
  • → Ingrian: miljona
  • → Khakas: миллион (million)
  • → Kazakh: миллион (million)
  • → Kyrgyz: миллион (million)
  • → Tatar:
    Cyrillic script: миллион (milliyon)
    Latin script: million
  • → Tajik: миллион (million)
  • → Turkmen: million
  • → Uyghur: مىليون (milyon)
  • → Uzbek: million
  • → Yakut: мөлүйүөн (mölüyüön)
